verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt served at docs.trykintsugi.com (HTTP 200, with a Kintsugi Developer Docs summary). First-party docs also describe an MCP server that lets AI coding assistants search the docs and the live OpenAPI spec directly. Missing for 10: the llms.txt contents are only shown as a brief excerpt with no evidence of depth or of an llms-full.txt variant, and the raw OpenAPI spec was not found at standard public paths.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.trykintsugi.com/llms.txt # Kintsugi Developer Docs

Once configured, your AI coding assistant can search Kintsugi's docs and the live OpenAPI spec directly, so it writes integration code against the current API instead of a stale copy of the reference.
Kintsugi's MCP server gives AI assistants direct access to our API documentation
